messages:
Riley (Support): Hi team, escalating a customer request. They want full proof that all data for customer `org_72f9` was deleted after a DSR earlier today. They specifically asked for KMS/HSM evidence and cross-region artefact removal. Need repro steps and what evidence we can provide.
Carlos (Customer Success): Customer is anxious; legal asked for a timeline. They want: 1) confirmation deletion completed, 2) audit logs showing delete ops, 3) KMS key usage logs showing envelope keys rotated/destroyed, and 4) confirmation of backups/snapshots removed.
Riley (Support): Case ID CS-2026-7782. Initial delete API call looks successful: `DELETE /v1/customers/org_72f9/data?request_id=dsr-2026-04-12` returned 204. Requestor attached partial request/response.
Devon (SRE): Quick q — which storage classes are in use for that org? If objects were archived (glacier/long-term) deletion may have separate retention.
Anika (Infra): org_72f9 had buckets in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; snapshots exist in snapshot-store-prod with lifecycle 90d. We need to check snapshot retention policies and whether the delete action triggered snapshot purge.
Riley (Support): Customer claims they issued delete on 2026-04-12 14:03 UTC. We mark request time.
Devon (SRE): I'll pull audit logs. audit-bot, can you export key usage for `projects/kms/redwood/keys/envelope-prod-2` for that timeframe?
audit-bot: Export job started: `export-audit-1876543210-1` -> will include admin/crypto operations, HSM-attestation events, and bucket delete markers. ETA ~10m.
Jane (Legal): Reminder: for DPA compliance we need chain-of-custody evidence. If HSM vendor cannot provide raw key material deletion logs, an attestation from the HSM vendor plus our internal KMS envelope key rotation/deprecation logs may suffice. Please collect vendor attestation options.
Anika (Infra): Note: our HSM does not expose raw key destruction events to control plane. We keep an HSM attestation bundle per customer export window. For KMS envelope keys we have logs in `kms-audit` index.
Devon (SRE): Pulled logs snippet for the delete call and downstream object removals:```2026-04-12T14:03:12Z support-api DELETE /v1/customers/org_72f9/data request_id=dsr-2026-04-12 status=204 user=svc-delete-role``` And S3 events:```2026-04-12T14:03:12Z s3 deleteObject bucket=redwood-org-72f9 obj=/data/partition-0001/part.blob delete-marker=true```
Riley (Support): Good. What else do we need to provide to the customer to be considered "proof"?
Jane (Legal): We should provide: 1) API request/response, 2) storage delete markers + lifecycle evidence that replicas were removed, 3) KMS envelope key rotation/deprecation entry (timestamp + key-id), 4) HSM vendor attestation or statement of non-recoverability, 5) list of subprocessors and whether they processed any customer blobs, and 6) note on backups/snapshot retention.
Carlos (Customer Success): Customer also asked for reproducible steps so an external auditor can validate deletion. Can we give a reproducible test flow with sanitized IDs?
Devon (SRE): We can provide a sanitized repro playbook: steps to call the delete API, sample curl, then show how to query `kms-audit` and `object-index` for deletion markers. Example:```# delete call
curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.com/v1/customers/<redacted>/data?request_id=<redacted>" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
# check audit
curl -s "https://logs.redwood.com/kms-audit/_search?q=request_id:dsr-2026-04-12"```
Anika (Infra): For snapshots: run `snapshotctl list --owner org_72f9 --before 2026-04-12` then `snapshotctl purge --id <snapshot-id>` we have audit traces for purge ops. But note: purging snapshots is asynchronous; retention window may delay actual physical removal.
Riley (Support): Customer expects deletion complete across regions within 24h. Do we have evidence all regions cleared?
Devon (SRE): From logs: eu-west-1 delete events at 14:03:15Z, us-west-2 at 14:03:18Z. Snapshot purge queued 14:05Z. I'll attach consolidated timeline.
audit-bot: Export job `export-audit-1876543210-1` completed: attached files -> kms-usage.csv, s3-deletes.jsonl, snapshot-purge.log, hsm-attest.pdf (vendor-provided).
Jane (Legal): HSM attestation received — vendor confirms HSM key handles associated with envelope-prod-2 were decommissioned on 2026-04-12 14:20 UTC and vendor-signed attestation is attached. This should be acceptable for DPA evidence.
Riley (Support): Drafting response to customer: include timeline, API request/response, s3 delete markers, KMS envelope key rotation/deprecation entries, HSM attestation, snapshot purge log, and subprocessor statement. Any redactions to do?
Carlos (Customer Success): Redact internal request IDs and any other customers' IDs. Keep timestamps, key-id suffix (last 4 chars) and hashes ok.
Devon (SRE): One more technical note for reproducible auditor steps: auditors cannot query HSM internals; provide them with our `hsm-attest.pdf` and a KMS audit export slice covering crypto operations:```# fetch kms audit slice
ecurl "https://logs.redwood.com/kms-audit/_search?size=1000&filter_path=hits.hits._source" -H "Authorization: Bearer <export-token>" -d '{"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"term":{"org_id":"org_72f9"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"2026-04-12T14:00:00Z","lte":"2026-04-12T15:00:00Z"}}}]}}}'```
Anika (Infra): Backup note: we have a cross-region backup retained for 30 days by policy. For compliance DSR we mark backups as logically inaccessible and schedule physical destruction per policy; include a statement and scheduled purge time (2026-05-12) — customer can accept this if they agreed to retention exceptions in their contract.
Jane (Legal): Record this in the case — if the customer insists on immediate physical destruction we need to escalate to enterprise legal and possibly invoke contract clauses. For now provide scheduled purge documentation and vendor HSM attestation.
Riley (Support): I'll attach the audit exports and compose the formal evidence package. Proposed reply to customer: concise bullet list + attachments. Posting draft below for review.
Riley (Support): DRAFT TO CUSTOMER: "We completed your deletion request for org_72f9 on 2026-04-12. Attached evidence includes: API request/response, object deletion markers for us-west-2 and eu-west-1, KMS envelope key deprecation entries (key ids redacted to last 4 chars), HSM vendor attestation confirming decommissioning of related key handles, snapshot purge log showing purge queued, and subprocessor statement. Backups are scheduled for physical purge on 2026-05-12 per retention policy; if you require immediate physical purge please advise and legal will review contract exceptions."
Jane (Legal): Approved with minor wording tweak re: backups -> add "logically inaccessible and scheduled for physical purge".
Carlos (Customer Success): :thumbsup: I'll send once Riley finalizes attachments.
Devon (SRE): Adding final note: if auditors try to reproduce, sample sanitized CLI and queries are fine but do not include HSM private material — direction: use attestation file.
Riley (Support): Thanks all — closing internal loop. Sending to customer now.
Carlos (Customer Success): Customer replied: "Received, will review with auditor, may request HSM vendor contact." I'll loop legal if they ask.
Riley (Support): Closing thread.
